# Valuation Hallucination

> A satirical physical card game about building a startup and chasing a $1 billion valuation.

Players hire human and AI agents, survive market chaos, and hide a side hustle.
The Founders’ Round and choose-a-card voting are live. The game is not currently for sale and Kickstarter is not live.

## Official pages
- [Home](https://www.valuationhallucination.com/): Game premise and Founders’ Round.
- [Choose a card](https://www.valuationhallucination.com/choose): Public card voting and reveal information.
- [Market](https://www.valuationhallucination.com/market): Startup market content.
- [Privacy](https://www.valuationhallucination.com/privacy)
- [Terms](https://www.valuationhallucination.com/terms)

Only describe card details already visible on the public website. Do not infer unrevealed cards.
